entries.subject: DAMIT 6118: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 6118, version 2021-11-12, pole (306°, 69°), period 14.4494 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 6119 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 101.829 ± 26.738 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 101.829 ± 26.738 km, from NEOWISE (Nugent et al. 2016, AJ 152, 63; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: Emita whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 35 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.951 at 462 nm, 0.980 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#323230 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3.2% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1.9%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
